title: Icon 180 Wired
text:
Icon 180 Wired.
SAFE SOUND, SIMPLE COMFORTIcon 180 is your everyday essential headphone—lightweight, comfortable, and simple by design. With an adjustable fit for all ages and a reliable wired connection, it’s ready for school, work, travel, and everything in between. Just plug in and press play for safe, easy listening whenever you need it.
Selected option: Crazy Pink.

title: Grom Wired
text:
Grom Wired.
KID-FRIENDLY SOUND AND COMFORT. Most kids' headphones look like toys. Kids don’t like it, and we don’t either. With Skullcandy Supreme Sound, intuitive earcup controls, a fit designed specifically for kids and sophisticated, modern styling, Grom is definitely not a toy.
Selected option: Bone Seafoam.

title: Icon 180
text:
Icon 180.
YOUR EVERYDAY STYLE ICON Icon 180 delivers everyday performance with Skullcandy's signature mix of comfort, durability, and simplicity. Built for your daily routine and ready for anything, it combines long battery life, a rugged build, and an ultra-comfortable on-ear fit. It’s wireless audio that looks clean, feels good, and works hard, all day, every day.
Selected option: True Black.

title: Icon ANC
text:
Icon ANC.
COMFORT, ACTION, NO DISTRACTIONS Almost 20 years ago, the OG Icon headphone blew up the boardsports world. The new Icon ANC is built better than ever with active noise canceling, sweat- and water-resistance and up to 60 hours of battery time. Icon ANC is just like the original, except it looks better, sounds better, and does way more cool stuff.
Selected option: Primer.

title: Riff Wireless 2
text:
Riff Wireless 2.
BOLD SOUND, UNPLUGGED.™ On-ear headphones are all about all-day battery and comfort, and Riff 2 is no exception. It delivers the goods affordably with 34 hours of battery life, a backup aux cable and the peace of mind that comes with Tile™ finding technology.
Selected option: True Black.

title: Hesh 360
text:
Hesh 360.
YOUR SOUND, YOUR STYLE Hesh 360 brings all the must-haves together: rich, dynamic sound, a super comfortable fit, and a clean, confident design that looks good anywhere. Whether you’re working, commuting, or just vibing out, Hesh 360 keeps things simple without cutting corners. And with access to the Skullcandy App, you can adjust your Stay-Aware levels and customize your EQ for a totally personalized experience.
Selected option: Future.

title: Hesh 540 ANC
text:
Hesh 540 ANC.
Surround Sound In Style Block out the noise. Dial up the vibe. With Active Noise Canceling and THX® Spatial Audio, Hesh 540 ANC doesn’t just play your music—it drops you right into it. Whether you're jamming, binging, or just zoning out, it’s all immersive, all day.
Selected option: Bone.

title: Crusher Evo
text:
Crusher Evo.
CRUSH THE ORDINARY WITH MIND-BENDING BASS Ready to feel your music? Crusher Evo brings the brain-rattling, soul-shaking power of adjustable Crusher Bass to your daily grind. It’s everything you need to crush commutes, couch sessions, and life in between. With up to 40 hours of battery life and Rapid Charge, you’ll never get caught without the vibes. And thanks to Personal Sound, it’s tuned just for you. Because your ears deserve better.
Selected option: Primer.

title: Crusher 540 Active
text:
Crusher 540 Active.
CRUSH THE ACTION WITH MIND-BENDING BASS Meet Crusher 540 Active, the ultimate active-use headphones designed to help you get in the zone to enhance your workout. Feel every beat with Crusher's adjustable sensory bass, pushing you to go harder when the workout gets tough. With a sweat and water-resistant nano-coating, Crusher 540 Active stays durable through your most intense sessions. Plus, its breathable fabric earpads keep you cool and comfortable when things heat up. Crush every beat, crush every workout.
Selected option: Soft.

title: Crusher ANC 2
text:
Crusher ANC 2.
CRUSH THE NOISE WITH MIND-BENDING BASS Welcome to your all-access pass to immersive sound. Crusher ANC 2 levels up your listening with adjustable sensory bass and customizable noise cancellation that adapts to your world, or blocks it out completely. Whether you’re front row at a sold-out show (in your head) or zoning in with zero distractions, you’re in control. Personalized sound? You got it. With the Skullcandy app, dial in your unique hearing profile, tweak the EQ, and even assign custom button functions. It’s your sound, your way.
Selected option: Hazard.

title: Aviator 900 ANC
text:
Aviator 900 ANC.
AUDIO ELEVATED Immerse yourself in 360° audio soundscapes, premium adaptive noise canceling and cutting-edge performance and features. Wrapped in unrivaled comfort and an iconic, retro-inspired design, Aviator 900 ANC sets a new standard for luxury listening — effortless, elevated, and unmistakably Skullcandy.
Selected option: True Black.

title: Crusher 1080 ANC
text:
Crusher 1080 ANC.
THE MOST REFINED CRUSHER BASS EXPERIENCE YET Crusher 1080 ANC combines Skullcandy's patented adjustable Crusher® Bass with premium Sound By Bose audio technologies for a listening experience like no other. Powerful noise canceling, immersive spatial audio, and bass you can feel make this our most advanced Crusher.
Selected option: True Black.

title: Crusher 720
text:
Crusher 720.
THE MOST INTENSE CRUSHER BASS EXPERIENCE YET Meet the next generation of Crusher. Crusher 720 takes everything you loved about Crusher Evo and turns it up with our most intense Crusher® Bass experience yet. Deeper and smoother than ever, the bass maintains Evo’s signature intensity while delivering more clarity, detail, and musicality. A redesigned Crusher wheel gives you more precise control over the bass, while THX® Spatial Audio creates a wider, more immersive listening experience. Deeper, softer ear cushions and an improved headband deliver a more comfortable fit, making it easier to listen longer. Add smarter controls, new features, and up to 65 hours of battery life for a Crusher experience that hits harder than ever.
Selected option: Future.

title: Crusher PLYR 720
text:
Crusher PLYR 720.
CRUSH EVERY LEVEL WITH MIND-BENDING BASS This isn’t just a headset — it’s your portal to new dimensions of sound. Featuring Crusher Bass, open-back acoustics, and THX Spatial Audio, Crusher PLYR 720 brings the game to life. Step into a 3D virtual world where you can feel the roar of dragons and the rumble of distant artillery. Live the game with Crusher PLYR 720.
Selected option: Digi-Black Xbox.
